page_title: MNT 2-1 MON | Montpellier v Monaco 17/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
90+6' One of the players from Monaco times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+3' Mika Biereth (Monaco) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Benjamin Lecomte easily deals with the threat.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mousa Al-Tamari departs the field of play to be replaced by Othmane Maamma (Montpellier).
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just over the bar.
89' Jean-Louis Gasset decides to make a substitution. Yael Mouanga will be replaced by Stefan Dzodic (Montpellier).
85' A corner kick by Monaco is thwarted by the well prepared Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier).
82' 2 - 1 Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) finds the back of the net with a strike from the edge of the penalty box, with the ball finding the bottom right corner of the goal.
81' Yael Mouanga (Montpellier) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jerome Brisard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
81' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
81' Lucas Michal just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) replaces him.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Eliesse Ben Seghir as he is replaced by Breel Embolo (Monaco).
76' Lucas Michal (Monaco) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' A corner kick by Monaco is thwarted by the well prepared Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier).
73' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the top right corner is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
73' Monaco force a corner. They send men into the box.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.
70' A player from Montpellier brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
69' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Benjamin Lecomte intercepts the ball.
68' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
67' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Vanderson (Monaco), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
65' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Radoslaw Majecki, who smothers the ball.
64' Today's match ends for Issiaga Sylla who will be replaced by Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier).
64' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to substitute Rabby Nzingoula and he is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
64' Here comes a substitution. Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is brought on as a substitute for Wahbi Khazri.
64' Lucas Michal (Monaco) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
63' Now Monaco have a corner.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
61' A substitution has been made. Maghnes Akliouche goes off and Lucas Michal (Monaco) comes on.
61' Here is a change. Jordan Teze is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to Vanderson (Monaco).
61' Substitution. Kassoum Ouattara is replaced by Caio Henrique (Monaco).
61' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
58' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take a corner kick.
57' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
57' Montpellier have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
56' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) for a tough tackle.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:1.
53' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

51' A neat pass is well received by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
51' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:8.
50' The linesman signals a throw-in for Montpellier.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A player from Montpellier commits a rough challenge. Jerome Brisard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Monaco win a corner.

45' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Benjamin Lecomte pulls off a brilliant save.
44' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) but poses no threat.
42' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
40' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
40' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post.
36' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Radoslaw Majecki.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Montpellier.
32' 0 - 1 Lamine Camara takes over corner duties and expertly finds Thilo Kehrer (Monaco), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the back of the net. The score is now 0:1.
32' Corner kick. Monaco will have an opportunity.
31' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
29' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game. One of the players from Montpellier won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
26' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Montpellier out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
25' The ball falls kindly for Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the left post.
25' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Benjamin Lecomte stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
22' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Montpellier was in an offside position.
21' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
20' The corner is swung in but Montpellier can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

19' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Montpellier are going to take it.
18' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
17' The referee signals a corner kick to Monaco.

17' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Benjamin Lecomte sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top right corner.
16' It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
15' Lamine Camara (Monaco) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
15' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Monaco.
14' Monaco take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
13' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Lamine Camara (Monaco) commits a foul after dangerous play.
11' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
10' Monaco have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Monaco fail to score from a corner as Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier) leaps to collect the ball.
8' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
6' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
6' Lamine Camara (Monaco) takes the corner with a short pass.

6' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
3' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
2' Monaco take a short corner kick.
2' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Benjamin Lecomte easily deals with the threat. Monaco get a corner.
1' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
1' The match has just started.
Montpellier will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Jerome Brisard.
